language.title: Language
language.label: Interface & assistant language
language.hint: Select language for Aemeath's interface and assistant responses.

interactive.title: Interactive mode
interactive.low_desc: Aemeath chats and talks with you normally.
interactive.medium_desc: Aemeath can observe active applications (browsing, gaming, etc.) and warn you when doomscrolling too long.
interactive.full_desc: More intensive than Medium: Aemeath detects open programs, social media, programming languages & test files while coding, window switching, and evaluates your work (/review) without screen capture.
interactive.medium_consent_title: Before enabling Medium, here is what happens:
interactive.medium_consent_1: Every few seconds Aemeath reads the active application name and window title.
interactive.medium_consent_2: Titles are discarded immediately after categorizing activity. Only category and app/game names are kept, and only in memory.
interactive.medium_consent_3: Nothing is saved to disk or sent to the internet, including to the chatbot.
interactive.medium_consent_4: Private windows (incognito, InPrivate), password managers, and lock screens are never read.
interactive.medium_consent_5: You can return to Low at any time, and reading stops immediately.
interactive.full_consent_title: Before enabling Full, here is what happens:
interactive.full_consent_1: Includes all Medium tracking, plus programming language and test file detection while coding, and reminders if you switch windows too frequently.
interactive.full_consent_2: Never captures or records the screen (lightweight on CPU/RAM).
interactive.full_consent_3: Private windows, password managers, lock screen, and UAC prompts are always skipped and never read.
interactive.full_consent_4: The /review command checks git diff status 100% locally on this computer and detects potential API key or .env leaks. No activity or code data is ever sent to the internet.

startup.title: Startup
startup.hint: Enabled by default, so Aemeath appears every time you turn on your computer. Disable here to remove the startup entry.

movement.title: Movement & display
movement.stay_still: Stay still (do not walk or fly)
movement.transparent_hint: Mouse clicks pass through Aemeath to windows behind. Useful if you accidentally click her over buttons. Use tray menu to toggle off.
movement.stay_still_hint: Aemeath stops flying around and stays in her current position. You can still drag her elsewhere, and she still chats and reacts. Can also be toggled from tray menu.

chatter.title: Chatter
chatter.toggle_label: Allow Aemeath to chat with you

chatbot.title: Chatbot & Model
chatbot.offline_fallback: Use local answers if internet or API key is unavailable
chatbot.web_search_label: Search the web for more accurate answers
chatbot.web_search_hint: Uses Wuthering Waves Wiki for game questions and Wikipedia for other topics. Search keywords are sent to those sites, and results are referenced with sources. Not a general search engine.
chatbot.offline_label: Chat offline without API key or internet
chatbot.offline_hint: When no API key or disconnected, Aemeath answers from local lorebook notes. If unknown, she advises checking online or setting an API key.
chatbot.streaming_hint: Displays real-time typing output (streaming) while AI generates answers. Turn off if you prefer the full response at once.
chatbot.key_hint_1: Keys are only stored locally on this machine, encrypted via system credential storage outside the project directory. Keys are never sent to repos, other windows, or anyone other than the provider.
chatbot.key_hint_2: Messages typed in chat are sent to the provider for generation. Conversation history lives only in memory and is discarded minutes after closing chat.

commands.title: Custom commands
commands.hint: Create custom command shortcuts to launch applications, URLs, or run scripts.
commands.builtin_hint: These commands are built into Aemeath. Their names are reserved, so custom commands cannot shadow them.
commands.terminal_hint: When /change-mode is invoked, Windows requests UAC elevation first. Once approved, the chat box becomes a PowerShell session running as your user (not admin), and only commands you type are executed. The chatbot does not participate, and the session ends upon closing the box, typing exit, or after 15 minutes of inactivity.
commands.custom_intro_hint: Type /name in chat to launch apps, folders, URLs, or PowerShell scripts (e.g. /invoice for documents, /wuwa for game launcher, or /matikan to shutdown). Type / alone to list commands. Executed 100% locally: never sent to the chatbot.
commands.target_hint: Target can be a full path to an application, file, or folder (supports %USERPROFILE%), or http:// / https:// URLs. Arguments only apply to .exe programs.
commands.shell_hint: PowerShell commands run as your current user (non-admin), single line, with 30s timeout. Dangerous commands (shutdown, format, delete, download-and-execute) always require confirmation. /matikan includes a 60s countdown cancellable with /batal.

memory.title: Companion memory
memory.description: Things Aemeath is allowed to remember while chatting with you.
memory.hint: Things you permit Aemeath to remember: current projects, pending tasks, design choices, and conversational preferences. Kept separate from the lorebook: game facts remain canon-sourced.
memory.toggle_hint: When disabled, nothing new is saved and no memories are attached to model prompts. Existing memories can be reviewed and deleted below.
memory.retention_label: AI summaries are cleaned up after
memory.retention_hint: Only summaries created automatically by Aemeath follow this rule. Memories you manually add are never deleted automatically.
memory.new_placeholder: For example: working on bilingual localization in aemeath-ai-agent.
memory.privacy_hint: Only relevant memories — at most 4 snippets — are attached to prompts when you send a message. All entries are stored locally in memory.json and can be deleted at any time.

appearance.title: Appearance & Theme
appearance.contrast_optimal: Optimal contrast quality: WCAG AA passed.
appearance.reduce_effects: Reduce visual effects (no blur, solid opacity, minimal animations)
appearance.preset_hint: Adjusting sliders automatically changes theme to Custom. Double-click any slider to reset to default.
appearance.export_hint: Exported theme files are secure JSON and can be shared or re-imported anytime.

shortcut_section.title: Keyboard shortcut
shortcut_section.label: Open or close chat box from anywhere
shortcut_section.hint: Press this shortcut anytime to quickly type messages or run /name commands without clicking Aemeath.

proactive.title: Proactive interactions
proactive.pause_hint: When enabled, Aemeath stops greeting and commenting on her own. Scheduled reminders via /timer and critical AI session alerts still appear. Same toggle is in the tray menu.
proactive.cooldown_hint: Applies to activity reactions, not spontaneous chatter intervals. Higher priorities win: AI decisions, failures, direct requests, timers, activity, then chatter. Chatter is held while typing in chat, idle, or during focus timers.
proactive.prio_hint: Adjust priority when multiple messages arrive simultaneously.
proactive.dnd_hint: During quiet hours, Aemeath will not greet or chatter casually. Critical alerts (like AI decisions and timers) will still be delivered.

lorebook.title: Lorebook & Wuthering Waves Wiki Data
lorebook.hint: Aemeath chats about Wuthering Waves facts from the local lorebook. You can update data from the Wuthering Waves Wiki anytime (leave blank for core pages like Solaris-3, Lore, and Resonator, or specify a page title/URL).

chat.empty: Type a message to start chatting with Aemeath.
chat.offline_notice: Offline mode: using local lore notes.
chat.greeting: Hi, Rover! What would you like to chat about? You can ask about Wuthering Waves too~

feature_guide.title: Aemeath Guidebook
feature_guide.dialogue_default: Rover~! I'm here accompanying you through the guidebook.
feature_guide.avatar_title: Click Aemeath for a bouncy greeting!
feature_guide.footer_left: Commands /help and /bantuan remain active and unchanged.
feature_guide.footer_right: Use Tab or Enter keys to navigate

errors.timeout: Request timed out. Please try asking again.
errors.busy: Aemeath is still thinking about the previous message.
errors.empty_search: Please write search keywords after /search, Rover.
errors.no_key: No API key for {provider} yet. Set it in Settings.
errors.unsupported_vision: Provider {provider} ({model}) does not support image input.
errors.search_failed: Sorry Rover, web search failed due to network issues or timeout. I won't guess without sources—please try again shortly.
errors.search_empty: I searched the web, but couldn't find valid sources for "{query}", Rover. I won't invent answers without proof—please try more specific keywords.
errors.search_secret: Sorry Rover, web search cannot be performed for this message.
